title: MathShow Ownership-Based Collision Gate
acceptance: Each visible element has an owner: its nearest <Control>/Group/Content ancestor. No comparisons are made within one owner.
Every cross-owner pair is compared: shards, labels, stickers, Spark frames and visible Flash/Glow layers.
Exemptions live only in games/mathshow/tests/studio/CollisionManifest.luau as exact path pairs, each with a reason. The log prints the manifest hit count and any manifest entry that never matched.
A planted-fault canary fixture is mandatory: the gate must flag it, and a run where the canary is not flagged fails.
Full gate at five viewports (844x390, 1920x1080, phone 812x375, 1024x768, 1180x820) with 0 unexplained failures; the log replaces the 'collision: NOT COVERED' row.
notes: Backlog. Replaces the heuristic collision gate removed from TASK-0114. Needs the exemption list written from measured pairs, not by name patterns.
